watchdog_reload_exhausted.description: Netatmo data has been unavailable for an extended period. The integration reloaded itself {attempts} times without recovering, and has stopped trying so it does not keep generating API traffic. Check your internet connection and the Netatmo service status, then reload the integration manually. If the problem persists, re-authenticate the integration.

webhook_registration_rejected.title: Netatmo push events could not be enabled
webhook_registration_rejected.description:
Netatmo refused to register the webhook and retrying cannot help:

`{error}`

This almost always means Home Assistant is not reachable from the internet over HTTPS on port 443, which Netatmo requires.

Either configure a public HTTPS URL under Settings > System > Network, or turn push events off in the integration options. Polling is unaffected - all data still arrives, just on the polling interval.

push_events.title: Push events
push_events.description:
Netatmo can push events (camera motion, thermostat mode changes) to Home Assistant instead of waiting for the next poll. This requires your Home Assistant to be reachable from the internet over HTTPS on port 443.

If it is not, leave this off: every registration attempt will be refused and the integration will keep retrying against a rate-limited account for nothing. All data still arrives by polling either way - only the speed of event-driven updates changes.

data_description.enable_webhook: Only enable this if Home Assistant has a public HTTPS URL on port 443, or you use Home Assistant Cloud.
